payload.title: Per-tenant usage meters, computed once on write
payload.description:
What: counters for the costly things (model spend, storage, requests, monitors, outbound mail) maintained when the work happens, read from an index and sent to Prospectus. No whole-table counts.
Acceptance:
Scenario: One model call adds one usage record
  Given a tenant runs one model call
  When usage is read
  Then the tenant's meter rose by that call's cost once
